meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Remove AI-generated code smells (slop) from branch changes or an explicit file list. Locks behavior with regression tests FIRST, then runs categorized cleanup via parallel `deep` agents in batches of 5, then verifies with quality gates. Covers 10 slop categories including performance equivalences, excessive complexity (object annotations, if/elif variant chains), and oversized modules (250+ pure LOC with mandatory modular refactoring). MUST USE when the user asks to "remove slop", "clean AI code", "deslop", "clean up AI-generated code", "remove AI slop", or wants to clean up AI-generated patterns from recent changes. Triggers - "remove ai slops", "clean ai code", "deslop", "cleanup AI generated", "remove AI slop", "clean up AI-generated code", "strip slop", "ai-slop cleanup".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测并清理AI生成的代码坏味道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要清理AI助手生成的冗余或低效代码
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect and clean AI-generated code smells
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clean up redundant or inefficient code from AI assistants

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求清理 AI 生成的代码时,Claude 会先为现有行为补回归测试,再分批移除常见 AI 代码异味(多余注释、死代码、过度复杂等),最后用质量检查验证;失败则自动回滚或直接修正。
howto.when: 当你说「remove AI slop」「clean AI code」「deslop」等关键词,或要求清理最近改动中的 AI 生成代码时触发;默认处理当前分支的改动,也可指定文件列表。

say.text: 请 remove AI slop,清理当前分支的 AI 生成代码。
say.note: Claude 会先补回归测试,再开始清理。

say.text: deslop 一下 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 这两个文件。
say.note: Claude 会按文件列表分批清理。

say.text: clean AI code,把最近改动里的 AI 代码痕迹清掉。
say.note: 行为会被测试锁定后再清理。

howto.what_en: Claude first locks behavior with regression tests, then batch-removes common AI smells (comments, dead code, complexity) from branch diffs or given files, then runs quality gates; on failure it reverts or directly fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'remove AI slop', 'clean AI code', 'deslop', etc., or asks to clean AI-generated patterns from recent changes. Default scope: branch diff or explicit file list.

say_en.text: Please remove AI slop from the current branch.
say_en.note: Claude writes regression tests first, then cleans.
Claude processes the listed files in batches.

say_en.text: Clean AI code in the recent changes.
say_en.note: Behavior is locked by tests before cleanup.
